Manga / Comic / Webtoon

FAQ 
Is refund supported? 
Request a refund at reportaproblem.apple.com. Apple reviews eligibility and determines the outcome and timing; approval and payment timing are not guaranteed. 
What Pro purchase options are available? 
Pro offers monthly and annual subscriptions and a one-time purchase. Check the in-app purchase screen for regional prices, renewal terms and included features. 
What formats are supported? 
Supports ZIP / EPUB / PDF / MOBI / CBR / CBZ / RAR / PNG / JPG / AZW3. File contents, encryption and DRM can affect compatibility. RAR/CBR require local extraction. 
Can I connect to NAS or cloud storage? 
Pro supports WebDAV, SMB, OPDS(Komga), Dropbox, iCloud Drive and selected cloud services. Compatible files can load on demand; RAR/CBR, mounted iCloud files and some PDFs download first. Import Google Drive files through the system Files app. 
How many devices can I use? 
Your bookshelf and reading progress sync via iCloud across all iPhones and iPads sharing the same Apple ID. Switch devices without losing anything.

apps.name: Manga Capsule: AI Comic Reader
apps.desc:
Manga Capsule is a reader designed for manga lovers, helping you enjoy both collecting and reading manga.
We love reading manga, and we also love product design. Our goal is to provide you with the best reading experience:

- Continue Reading Across Devices
    From iPhone to iPad, Manga Capsule works seamlessly across all iOS devices. And yes—it also runs smoothly on M-series Macs.

- Multiple Formats, Smooth Reading
    Supports popular formats including EPUB, MOBI, PDF, ZIP, RAR, JPG, PNG and more. Even large files open quickly.

- Local, NAS & Cloud Storage
    Connect via WebDAV and SMB, or link Aliyun Drive. You can also download cloud files for offline reading.

- Reading Modes for All Styles
    Whether it’s Japanese right-to-left, Western left-to-right, or webtoon vertical scroll, Manga Capsule adapts. Optimized layouts for big screens, plus multiple page-turning modes: panning,
